mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5% (20-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates economic weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0 (20-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increase (>0.2pp in 3 months) and unemployment rate decrease (>0.1pp in 3 months) signal a 'Goldilocks' economy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition (FEDFUNDS rise >0.2pp and UNRATE fall >0.1pp in 3 months).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1400 thousand units indicate late-cycle expansion, leading to S&P 500 underperformance over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1400.0 (20-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 0.5% month-over-month signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated earnings expectations.
evidence_refs: doc:Industrial Production and Equity Market Correlation
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5% m/m (20-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth exceeding 0.8% month-over-month indicates strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days via improved corporate revenue outlook.
evidence_refs: doc:Retail Sales and Equity Market Performance
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth > 0.8% m/m (20-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth above 0.5% month-over-month combined with housing starts growth above 0.3% month-over-month signals synchronized economic strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% m/m AND HOUST growth > 0.3% m/m
evidence_refs: doc:Labor Market and Housing Demand Synergy
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition (PAYEMS growth >0.5% m/m and HOUST growth >0.3% m/m).

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 3.0% year-over-year triggers anticipation of aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y (20-year rolling window).
